summary: Steel tower, 30 m, that the register dates to 2018; the Chisholm fire lookout reported the 2001 Chisholm fire and later ran a camera system.

access.note: Register lists the tower as active with drive access. No source found says whether the public may visit the site.

events.note: Register gives 2018 as the year of construction for the tower.
Wildfire started about 10 km south of Chisholm on May 23, 2001 and was reported to the Chisholm fire lookout. It burned 104,000 hectares.
A video camera system was designed for the lookout in 2007 and 2008 (FPInnovations report). A 2013 FPInnovations page gives 2009 for the portable tower system at the lookout.

corrections.why: The register lists the tower as active with drive access. It does not describe the site as closed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2015 magazine article says the first camera system used a portable, collapsible tower. The 2015 FPInnovations report says the 2007-2008 system worked, and that a later design was asked to avoid the CN Rail trackside tower. The two accounts disagree and the story reports both.
The 2015 report dates the successful system to 2007 and 2008. A 2013 FPInnovations page gives 2009 for the portable tower system at this lookout. The story gives both dates.

notes_for_editor: Brief said built 2018; the register gives 2018 as the construction year of the present tower, but a 2001 article shows the Chisholm fire lookout was already in service. No source found ties that lookout to the same spot as the present tower, or says what stood there before 2018, so the story does not say. Brief access closed is corrected to restricted (active, drive access). Agency is taken from the Alberta.ca bears page wording (Wildfire staff with Agriculture and Forestry); the brief said Alberta Wildfire. Staffing as of 2001 is inferred from the fire report; no later staffing status was found. The 2015 IAWF article's author is not shown on the fetched page. The register query used is the all-records query (where=1=1) because the name-filtered query returned a server error. No source describes the site today. Both 2015 articles were checked; the magazine and FPInnovations report disagree on the first camera tower and the story says so.
